component.name: ScribeSense
component.summary: Wider letter, word and line spacing for reading, across the desktop

description.p: ScribeSense applies your reading spacing (letter, word and line spacing, base font and text size) to the whole desktop: GTK and Qt apps, Flatpak apps and the browsers. It builds spaced copies of open fonts and changes each app's settings through a journal, so every change can be undone.
Every change is shown first and kept only if you press Keep; otherwise it is undone after 30 seconds. "Restore original" puts every setting back. A reader window shows selected text in your spacing.
Before removing the package, run "Restore original" or "scribesense uninstall" so your settings are restored.
